contact.basis: Fixed plaza source point beyond the native southern stair foot before independent terrain; Y0 is architectural plaza grade, not a surveyed threshold.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Moon pyramid, front platform and axial stair frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.2m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Coarse coastal composite may not resolve coastal structures, submerged seabed or tidal elevation; exact approach/rock grade classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
